Name: Long Animal Names
Author: AnotherPillow
Description:
Allows you to name your animals with names as long as your heart desires by uncapping the max length of the text box. Supports farm animals, pets and horses. Also works for renaming animals after purchase.

If you uninstall it, probably will work fine still but if you open the query menu of an animal it will get cut off.

source: https://git.pillow.rocks/pillow/longanimalnames
